name: Guardian onboarding and class-specific lesson filtering
covers: class switch resets stale topic and search filters
MSc study level absent from all class selectors
description: Verifies each learner sees the complete lesson list for their selected class.
steps: Sign in as a guardian
Select a Class 7 learner
Choose a topic filter and enter a search term
Switch to Class 9
Switch back to Class 7
Inspect the class selector and confirm MSc is not offered
expected: Each class change clears the previous topic and search filters, all lessons for the selected class are shown, and MSc is absent from the study-level choices.

name: Roadmap displays actual lesson count separately from topic areas
covers: topic checklist count distinct from lesson count
description: Checks that the roadmap never labels topic headings as lesson cards.
steps: Open Class 7 and compare the roadmap count with visible lesson cards
Open Class 9 and compare the count
Open Class 10 and compare the count
expected: The roadmap lesson number matches the number of lesson cards currently displayed; topic areas are labelled separately.

name: Lesson access and learning materials
covers: Class 10 life processes and environment lessons
topic-matched lesson photographs and scientific illustrations
uploaded labelled reference diagrams in matching Class 11 and NEET lessons
dedicated concept maps in all ten NEET unit lessons
description: Checks representative lessons across the affected classes and verifies topic-matched lesson imagery.
steps: Open a Class 7 plant lesson and inspect its lesson-card photograph
Open a Class 9 cell lesson and inspect its scientific cell illustration
Open a Class 10 lesson
Open the Class 11 Cell: The Unit of Life lesson and inspect the plant and animal cell references
Open a NEET heart or reproductive-system lesson and inspect its supplied labelled diagrams
Open NEET Unit 3 and inspect its dedicated concept map, then open another NEET unit and confirm its diagram labels match that unit
Read the explanation and open the quiz
expected: Relevant lessons show their matching uploaded images and labelled reference diagrams, and each selected lesson opens with its explanation, diagram guidance and quiz.

name: Original Bio Bunny identity and learner progress
description: Checks the count and filtering fix does not disturb the app's existing learner experience.
steps: Select a learner profile
Complete one lesson
Return to the home page
Inspect the Bio Bunny logo
expected: Progress remains saved for the selected learner and the original sunny logo remains unchanged.
